title: Coedia Network
tagline: Decentralized social network to solved high-priority code issues using a help-and-earn open-source framework to build a wider, stronger and united Dev community.
description:
We build a decentralized social network where devs can solve high-priority web3 issues between them through a Help-and-earn framework: Requested Issues with customizable Bounties and sanctions, resolutions of issues with asynchronous rewards and a global reputational score to create a participative and cooperative web3 builders' community. Each proposal is given and updated by community itself.  
 
We build this to recue Web3Devs from burnout of enterprises, staked projects due to early stage devs facing advanced code challenges and involuntary isolation of leads with saturated inboxes due to repetitive solved-issues. At the end, we are aiming to reduce efforts and times used by devs adopting new skills at the same time that contribute to the evolution of a wider, stronger and united web3 community.
how_its_made:
Polygon Blockchain, Lens Protocol’ API, IPFS/Filecoin, Metamask 
We develop a user Interface that show up all the commands interactions which issues are minted after being resolved. NFTs are deploy by each request (post) and is faced by devs to solved and claim rewards as bounties, collectibles or global reputation score.
